editorial:
Imagine moving into a quiet, old farmhouse to start a new life with your partner and a tiny baby. That is exactly what happens here, but the dream quickly turns into a nightmare. You follow a young mom who is struggling with her mental health after having her son. The vibe is super creepy because you are never quite sure if the scary things happening are in her head or if the house is actually cursed. It creates a lot of tension as you wonder if she is losing her grip on reality or if there is something truly evil hiding in the walls.

The acting is solid and makes the scary moments feel real. The pacing starts off slow to build the mood, but it picks up with some shocking twists that keep you guessing. While some parts might feel a bit predictable if you watch a lot of horror, the scares are still effective. If you love movies about haunted houses and family secrets, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the house really is haunted by a dark force, but it feeds on the mother's mental state. In the final scenes, you find out that the ghosts are manipulating her to hurt her own family. After a scary battle with the spirits, the movie ends on a grim note. It shows that the evil in the house cannot be easily beaten, leaving you wondering if the family ever truly escaped the nightmare.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves haunted house stories and psychological twists.
